scope: Batek 1975–1976 development benchmark only; not independent population or ancient validation
data_audit: Check sorted count, zero anchors, monotonic cumulative gains and additive resource identities. Published R fits value directly as cumulative gain; do not trust daily-return wording without checking.
sensitivity_resource: tot_rat (wild foods plus rice-equivalent rattan proceeds); not prehistoric food
fit_target: Daily increments reconstructed by differencing cumulative gains; no zero anchor treated as observed day
validation: Leave one complete camp out, all rows and resource sets at that camp excluded from training; all seven folds reported. Camps share one population and observation campaign, so external validity remains untested.
weighting: Equal total squared-error weight per training camp; no held-out outcome normalization
scores: relative improvement over training-only constant baseline
fitting: Fixed positive bounded multistart least squares; amplitude 0.01–10000000 kcal per capita; shape time/rate bounds 0.0001–1000. No changing candidates after seeing scores.
adoption_gate: No geographic default from this benchmark. Improvement here only qualifies a candidate for further evaluation. Do not infer residence duration from the held-out camp's fitted full trajectory, stored Avg or observed departure.
interpretation: Estimated resource returns combine availability, effort, sharing and measurement; a decreasing curve alone does not uniquely identify physical depletion. Published environmental Avg includes the study sample and must not be used as an independent held-out predictor.
